decisions.reason: The armpit/arm-shoulder cavity definition is direct human anatomy appropriate to Fitness. Do not substitute the specialized insect-body definition.
The candidate adds that a bacteria-killing substance is especially otherwise harmless, an unnecessary safety implication. Seek a clearer lexical definition before teaching the medical term.
The upholstered restaurant/lounge bench definition exactly fits seating in the booth context. Military platforms, vehicle seats and regional sidewalks remain unselected.
Preserve the prior withholding: the projector sense is explicitly chiefly non-native speakers' English. Do not promote it as an ordinary modern technical synonym.
The source's parenthetical cooked ground-beef sandwich explanation is self-contained and matches hamburger dining vocabulary. Patty-only and raw ground-beef senses are not selected.
Writing appreciated for aesthetic value rather than content is the precise literary meaning. Restrict to Academic; the other sense only points to unexplained belles-lettres.
An act of charity/almsgiving fits charitable donation vocabulary. Do not add an unsupported requirement that the donation be large or formally philanthropic.
OEWN verifies a collection of books, directly related to library. The old prestigious-building and poetic-register claims are not included.
The biochemical catalyst definition explicitly includes enzymes and fits Academic chemistry/biology. Exclude the Fitness enzyme extension and do not reduce all biocatalysts to protein enzymes.
An action/substance destroying organisms is the sourced broad biological meaning relevant to pesticides. This does not assert safe application or practical killing instructions.
The source describes microbial decomposition of material, not human digestion in Fitness. Keep this mismatched environmental-science extension hidden.
The exact genetic-engineering meaning is appropriate to Academic biology. Do not approve the broader unsupported gloss covering every hereditary aspect of biology or general TOEIC use.
A scientist specializing in biosciences is a clear occupational meaning matching biologist. No claim that biologist is too general or that the work must be in a laboratory is approved.
The source explicitly explains statistics applied to biological/medical data. Restrict to Academic, excluding unrelated general Business/TOEIC statistics extensions.
Indentured servitude and slavery are not interchangeable. The only proposed slave connection and terse indentured-servant definition do not establish a suitable learner explanation.
A library bookshelf is a self-contained meaning appropriate to bookcase vocabulary. Unsupported height, fixed construction and exclusivity claims are not imported.
The cached complete definitions concern slang, historical shoe-cleaning work or a fleet, not footwear. The prior plural-identity gap remains; do not publish an unrelated meaning.
The English French/French-style bakery definition directly fits dining vocabulary. It does not establish an absolute bread-only restriction.
Organ stops, bagpipe pipes and bells belong to music, not Fitness pedal. The botanical/insect and pilgrim-staff alternatives do not resolve the topic mismatch.
The verified decorative/shoelace knot is not the exercise/body-bending sense of the Fitness bow anchor. Keep the uncertain topic connection hidden.
The upper-arm muscle flexing the elbow is an explicit anatomical definition relevant to the Fitness flexor anchor. It remains a specific muscle, not every flexor.
The skull/braincase meaning directly matches anatomy. Preserve the Canada/US colloquial labels so it is not presented as formal anatomical terminology; exclude the mind sense.
The source says a small informal restaurant serving beer/wine and simple food. This fits restaurant/cafe vocabulary while rejecting the old larger/more-formal comparison.
The Bromus-grass definition does not fit the ordinary cheating/chess senses in Academic, Business or Fitness. Do not reproduce the old botanical homonym confusion.
Forage grasses do not match the ordinary cheating context of the existing cheat anchors. The technical botanical meaning alone does not justify publication for these lists.
Plant buds and hollow anatomical bulbs do not establish the intended meaning of general TOEIC bulb. Keep the specialist/homonym correspondence uncertain.
A bulk dry-goods cargo ship directly matches freight transport. Do not select freight assessors, body-mass gainers or supplements.
A shot hitting a target's centre is clear and related to target. Choose this self-contained sense instead of the definition with unexplained inner/magpie scoring terms; no whole-target equivalence.
The source is dated/slang nonsense, but the Academic/TOEIC jazz anchor most naturally concerns music. The old claim that it is more formal than jazz is also unsupported.
A submarine-cable telegram is a specific communication meaning fitting cable. The rare derived verb and comparative formality claims are not selected.
The valid retractable-top car meaning still has only a Business convertible anchor that may concern financial instruments. Preserve the previous unresolved sense/topic decision.
A flattering persuader is unrelated to a Fitness smoothie beverage. This is a clear sense mismatch, not a missing-example issue.

The source explains a strong life-direction urge with examples within the definition. This matches vocation/career purpose without requiring every calling to be spiritual or approving unrelated niche senses.
Camera skill/technique, especially video, is explicitly sourced and relevant to photography. Preserve countability labels; no unsupported artistry ranking is introduced.

Military quarters/stations are specialist senses not established by the generic NGSL camp anchor. Definitions also distinguish temporary and regional permanent uses, so the old blanket permanent-camp claim is unsafe.
